verdict: Ads have been dark since Sep 17 — relaunch is the immediate priority.
narrative: All paid advertising paused on September 17 and has run at zero spend for 19 consecutive days, which is why lead volume has fully stopped in the back half of this period. The 48 leads reported were earned before the pause, all from Meta at a cost of $16.20 per lead — a solid result for the days ads were running. Google Ads spent $201 over the 28-day window and recorded zero conversions; conversion tracking is being repaired so Google spend can be properly evaluated and optimized going forward. Ads are being brought back on, overdue setup milestones are being closed out, and the expectation for next period is restored lead flow with full attribution in place.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta during the days ads were active
cost per lead on Meta — efficient for the days campaigns ran
consecutive days with zero ad spend, ending lead and call volume entirely

watch_item.issue: Paid ads have been off since September 17, and Google conversion tracking is not yet recording results, leaving that spend unaccountable.
watch_item.fix: Ads are being relaunched this week and conversion tracking is being connected so every dollar of spend ties to a measurable outcome.
